description: A plugin for showcasing agency projects with custom post type, taxonomy, shortcode, and AJAX load-more functionality.

shortcodes.description: Lists recent portfolio projects, optionally filtered by project-type slug, rendered as an escaped grid.

ajaxActions.description: AJAX load-more handler for portfolio projects. Public (logged-out visitors allowed). MUST verify nonce, sanitize all input (page number, post count, type slug), and only return published content (never drafts/private). Returns escaped HTML of next page of projects.

dataStorage: Portfolio projects stored as custom post type 'prtf_portfolio' with core WP posts table. Project Type taxonomy stored in core terms/term_taxonomy tables. Featured images via core post meta (_thumbnail_id). No custom tables required.
securityRequirements: Escape all output (esc_html, esc_attr, esc_url) in shortcode and AJAX responses
Nonce verification required for AJAX load-more action (check_ajax_referer)
Sanitize all AJAX input: page number (absint), count (absint), type slug (sanitize_key)
AJAX handler MUST only query post_status='publish' to prevent exposure of drafts/private posts
Taxonomy term names escaped with esc_html when displayed
